title: Tender Executive Female Candidate
description:
Tender Sourcing & Tracking: Monitor portals like GeM (Government e-Marketplace) , CPPP, IREPS, state e-procurement sites, and private platforms for relevant business opportunities. Document Analysis: Review tender notices, eligibility criteria, scope of work, Bill of Quantities (BOQ), Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) rules, and commercial terms. Cross-Functional Coordination: Gather technical data, compliance certificates, drawings, and quotations from internal engineering, production, finance, and legal teams. Bid Preparation: Compile technical proposals, financial bids, pricing comparative statements, and statutory documentation. Portal Submission & Tracking: Upload bids online, monitor corrigenda and amendments, attend pre-bid meetings, and manage physical bid packages if required. Post-Bid Follow-up: Track tender opening results, handle query clarifications, manage EMD/Bank Guarantee refunds or conversions, and maintain a centralized tender log/tracker

Key Skills: Bidding,Tender preparation,Tendering,e-tendering,Gems,Government Tender,Gem Portal
